objective.value: AI-powered enhancement of underwater photographs with a full pipeline from training to a production-style web interface.

role.value: Sole Developer — dataset prep, model design, training, evaluation (PSNR/SSIM), Grad-CAM, FastAPI, React, end-to-end deploy architecture.

overview.value: AI image enhancement platform restoring underwater photos via custom AttentionResUNet; full pipeline training → production-style deployment; FastAPI backend + React frontend.

decisions.value: Turning research into usable software — balance quality, inference speed, API, frontend, deployment as one product.

lessons.value: Containerize inference early; improve GPU deploy; async for larger workloads; stronger experiment tracking; cleaner model serving separated from app logic.
